packageRules.description: Hold pnpm at 11. pnpm 12 ships a native binary installed by a postinstall script and no longer carries bin/pnpm.cjs, which is what corepack and pnpm's own pre-11 launcher start. With pnpm@12 in packageManager, both fail with MODULE_NOT_FOUND before any command runs, so the repository cannot be installed locally. CI is unaffected because pnpm/action-setup installs pnpm itself. Lift this once corepack can launch pnpm 12, or once the project drops corepack for pnpm's own version management.
